messages:
tara: Heads-up: multiple tenants reporting SSO login failures and SCIM 403s since 06:12 UTC. Symptoms: failed introspect (401) and provisioner Decrypt AccessDenied for the same timeframe.

evan: paste from sso-proxy logs for tenant `grove-inc`:
```
2026-03-28T06:11:58Z WARN sso/proxy.go:317 introspect failed: 401 invalid_token (token_kid_unknown). req=7f3c
2026-03-28T06:12:04Z ERROR scim/provisioner.go:201 decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: user is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/ef01
 tenant=grove-inc req=7f4b
```

ryan: interesting - two problems overlapped. Azure AD sent a metadata rotation at ~06:10 (we see their admin webhook), and we had a scheduled `kms-grant-audit` job at 06:09 that pruned stale grants. Could be a timing race.

tara: I also see a stale long-lived grant for `svcacc:onboard-worker` on that key that our inventory doesn't list. vuln team flagged it last month but it wasn't remediated. If the prune removed the grant the active provisioner relied on, that explains Decrypt denies.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) quickly re-create a minimal grant for `infra:scim-provisioner` so decrypts resume, 2) force JWKS refresh in sso-proxy to pick up new kid, 3) throttle back the prune job and add tagging guardrails.

evan: forcing JWKS refresh: `curl -s https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/discovery/keys | jq '.keys[] | {kid}'` then restart sso-proxy pods. Doing canary first.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/sso-proxy v0.9.5 (commit f3d2a1) - 2026-03-28T06:22:12Z

tara: re-created grant and restarted provisioner pods. Local decrypt test OK. KMS denies drop to 0 in the next 2m.

ryan: JWKS refresh fixed the introspect 401s for most tenants. However, some tenants still have membership changes queued in SCIM that failed during the window; we'll need to backfill.

audit-bot: automated note: recorded 94 failed SCIM operations and 28 failed introspects between 2026-03-28T06:08:00Z and 2026-03-28T06:25:00Z. Linked incident SEC-2026-064.

evan: root causes: (A) aggressive grant-prune removed an in-use grant due to missing `in-use-by` tag, (B) IdP JWK rotation triggered token_kid mismatch and our backoff prevented immediate key refresh. Secondary finding: stale onboard svcacc had an untracked grant (vuln).

tara: actions: 1) add idempotent guard to kms-prune job to skip grants with `in-use-by` or `infra-managed=true`; 2) change sso-proxy to immediately fetch JWKS on token_kid_unknown (no backoff for first failure); 3) inventory and retire stale svcaccs with grants (vuln team).

ryan: also add a post-rotation verification step: after any IdP metadata/JWKS rotate, assert at least one successful introspect per active tenant within 5 minutes. Failures should open a P1-Triage alert.

tara: running backfill: `./scripts/scim_replay --window 2026-03-28T06:00:00Z,2026-03-28T06:30:00Z --concurrency 8` - currently 61/94 completed.

sre-oncall: suppressed paging for `scim.decrypt.errors` while mitigation in progress. Keep thread updated when backfill finishes.

evan: PRs inbound: infra#5382 (kms-prune guard), auth#2291 (jwks-refresh-on-401), ops#187 (svcacc inventory). Will attach test plan.

tara: notifying CS with impacted tenant list and ETA for backfill. Filing short, blameless postmortem and linking runbook updates to SEC-2026-064. Closing thread when backfill and postmortem done. :white_check_mark:
